snippet.title: Malevilent - Cinematic Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A missing envoy. No telegraphs for a month. Something's gone wrong in the mining town of Gunsight, Arizona. As an agent of the newly-formed Federal Secret Service, it's your job to get to the bottom of what's happening in Malevilent, a new third-person, open-world RPG from Gadget Games. 

Wishlist Malevilent now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3598050/Malevilent/
Join Malevilent on Discord: https://discord.gg/XH4EkRMzTR
Follow Malevilent on X/Twitter: https://x.com/Malevilentgame
Follow Malevilent on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/malevilent.bsky.social

Malevilent is developed on Unity 6.2
